description: Validate a JSON model output against a schema, locate every violation, and coerce the fields that can be repaired. After an LLM call, before trusting or storing its structured output. Do not choose this when you need full JSON Schema compliance including combinators. Example requests: Check this model output against my schema. | Guard my LLM JSON output and fix what can be fixed. | Validate this structured output and repair it.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

output.description: The customer's output.json, as text. Supported: JSON. The model output to check. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

schema.description: The customer's schema.json, as text. Supported: JSON Schema subset. The required schema. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.

name: submit_llm_output_schema_guard
title: LLM output schema guard
